describes: The history layer registry (decisions §5 D5.6). Each layer names its page and channel, its inputs, the owner of its curve and what resets it. A layer's value at a date is its material's curve at rate x (date - reset + age offset): the page holds the rate, the piece table or facts buffer the reset year, h1.a the age offset (schemas/interval.schema.json). Every shader reads a layer through OS_History(address, layer) in one include, so a new layer takes a reserved channel or a new page and touches that include, never a kind. shared: baked on every page group. story: allocated per page group by the change query's weight, up to a cap; a group without it reads the material's quiet mean.
